#HMPV
Hmpv virus-Human metapneumovirus (HMPV or hMPV) HMPV typically causes symptoms similar to those of other respiratory infections, such as:
1.Fever
2.Cough
3.Nasal congestion
4.Shortness of breath
5.Sore throat https://t.co/NwtSg1aQhv
